items.difficulty_reason: 33 行、与 L22121 平行的 Noetherian 逼近模板（对象从张量积换成内 Hom）：①引用同章 base-change-RHom 引理把命题压缩成「证 K 完美」，Noetherian 情形由 ext-perfect 引理给出；②仿射化后 R = colim R_i，按顺序下降 X_i、G_i^bullet（有界有限表现）、平坦性、支撑真性、E_i（descend-perfect），每次 increasing i；③对 R_i 应用 Noetherian 情形，再用已证的 base change 性质传回 R。承重的逼近下降链条全在 span 内；8 处引用（3 同章、5 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-base-change-RHom-perfect (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 7842-7853

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the citation of the already-proven base change part, the reduction of perfection to the Noetherian case, the descent of the whole datum over a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings by the Limits lemmas, and the application of the Noetherian internal-Hom lemma to the descended datum together with the base change property (source lines 7855-7887)
